From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: May forecast tidy: leadership packet inputs & stage-lock window

Team — quick alignment for the May leadership packet and the upcoming stage-lock window. We need a concise extract for leadership that calls out:
- Commits (green/orange/red) through the 14th
- Any late-stage risks and mitigation asks
- Confirmed close dates & expected ARR recognition month

Action items (please):
1) By EOD Monday (5/17) update the attached commit list (commit_list_20270514.csv) with final expected close dates and mark deals that require executive review.
2) Where you mark a deal as "exec review", include a one-line reason (risk, pricing, legal, security).
3) Send any customer-facing blockers (procurement, SOC2 evidence delays) so we can separate them in the leadership excerpt.

I'm compiling the leadership_excerpt_v1.pptx on Tue morning and will circulate for comments. If you have a deal that needs temporary stage-lock extension, note it in the CSV and reply with the reason — we'll route to Markus for exception approval.

Attachment: commit_list_20270514.csv (csv) — please edit and re-upload to the Drive link below; I will pull the final table into the leadership PPT.

Thanks — Mina

Following up — I've updated the CSV with the three late-stage items that changed this morning. Notes:
- Brightline (Tanya cc'd) moved paperwork to procurement this morning; expected signature is 5/24 but procurement requested a short data-retention clause change. Marked as "exec review" because it could delay recognition into June.
- ACME-Supply (SMB) pushed 2 weeks — pulled to "commit watch".
- One upsell (internal) we are accelerating to close this week — green.

Tanya, quick ask: any update on procurement timeline from your side? If you can acknowledge the proposed data-retention language, we can lock the date.

On Mon, 17 May 2027 at 09:40 AM Tanya Brooks <tanya.brooks@brightline.com> wrote:
> Hi Karthik / team — thanks for the heads up. Procurement is reviewing the clause now; I expect a response by EOD 5/18. If there are material legal changes we'll flag them, otherwise we'll push to sign.
> 
> —Tanya

From: Tanya Brooks <tanya.brooks@brightline.com>

Karthik — procurement confirmed they will accept the retention language with a one-line addendum (attached). Expect sign-off by 5/18 evening. If Redwood needs a PO to attach to the contract we can get that after signature; procurement prefers the contract+SOW route.

Best,

Subject: Final leadership excerpt & next steps (May packet)

Appreciate the quick updates. I'm attaching the draft leadership excerpt (leadership_excerpt_v1.pptx) and a one-page summary (May_forecast_summary.pdf) that will go into the pack. Highlights pulled from the CSV:
- Brightline: moved to exec review (procurement clause in progress) — potential recognition slip to June if legal requests changes > minor handshake (we're tracking).
- ACME-Supply: commit watch — moved two weeks; no exec ask.
- Upsell bundle: on-track for May recognition (green).

Next steps:
- Grace / Karthik / Lauren: final check of any "exec review" descriptions (one line) by EOD 5/17. I will submit the leadership pack to Markus after edits and request approval for any stage-lock exceptions.
- Markus: will review exec exceptions and provide decision by Tue 5/18 morning.

Attachments: leadership_excerpt_v1.pptx (pptx), May_forecast_summary.pdf (pdf)
